normalWorkflow: drop an unextracted Havenwild_Patch_*.zip, Havenwild_IncrementalPatch_*.zip, Havenwild_Handoff_*.zip, Havenwild__*.patch, or HW-*.patch transport into the repository root
launch HavenwildTools.cmd; startup patch scan may prompt before entering the internal PCC menu
approve only the patch transports intended for the current repository state
choose option 1 / Full quality gate to certify the current source after patch intake
patch intake validates paths, hashes, manifests, or Git unified-diff apply checks before changing source
patch intake transactionally backs up and applies controlled overwrite/removal data for manifest ZIP transports
Git unified-diff transports are checked with git apply --check and safe path validation before application
successful patch transports are archived outside the repository root
root cleanliness audit runs only after consumed patch transports have left the root
after manual editor/runtime testing, option 2 commits and pushes the certified GREEN source
If a text .patch does not apply during startup prompt mode, archive it to artifacts/updates/failed and keep the internal PCC menu usable.

safety.manifest: PATCH_MANIFEST.json with schema havenwild.root_patch.v1 for manifest ZIP transports
safety.allowedApplyMode: overwrite for manifest ZIP transports; git-unified-diff for text patch transports
safety.startupPrompt: HavenwildTools.ps1 may call InvokeRootPatchIntake.ps1 -Prompt to ask before applying each pending root patch.
rejects: Git unified-diff paths outside the repository root
safety.gitUnifiedDiffFailureHandling: Plain git apply is checked first; 3-way git apply is allowed for text patches. Prompt-mode startup failures are archived and reported without trapping the PCC menu; Full Gate still fails on unchanged bad patches.

rootPolicy: Consumed patch transports are archived before normal root cleanliness assertion. Patch transports never become repository-root source authority.
preservationPolicy: This hardening preserves existing manifest ZIP intake and patch 10 standalone PCC behavior while making failed text .patch transports diagnosable and non-poisoning at startup.
